# Celt Industries

> Celt Industries is a TSBC-licensed refrigeration and gas contractor in Langley, British Columbia. It installs, maintains and repairs industrial and commercial refrigeration, HVAC/R, mechanical and electrical systems, and installs gas detection and ozone filtration systems. It serves the Fraser Valley and Lower Mainland and offers 24/7 emergency response.

## Key facts
- Founded: 2022
- Founder and service manager: Clayton Betker, journeyman refrigeration mechanic and electrician
- Service area: Fraser Valley and Lower Mainland, British Columbia, Canada
- Licences: TSBC refrigeration contractor and gas contractor
- Emergency service: 24/7
- Phone: 604-799-6168
- Email: cbetker@celtindustries.com
- Industries served: food processing, property management, marine and fishing, industrial and manufacturing, commercial facilities
- Equipment brands: Navien, A.O. Smith, Danfoss, Vilter

## Services
- Industrial and commercial refrigeration
- Marine and fishing refrigeration
- HVAC/R
- Mechanical preventative maintenance, repairs and upgrades
- Electrical troubleshooting and maintenance
- Gas detection and monitoring systems
- Ozone filtration installation and planning
- Energy-saving refrigeration upgrades
